# Macau Sauna Sites

> Independent multilingual editorial guide to Macau sauna and spa venues, practical visit planning, venue status, and travel information.

This file is generated during every production build. Venue availability and commercial details can change; use the linked pages as editorial references and confirm time-sensitive details before travel.

## Current Venue Guides

- [Yu Sauna](https://sex-macau.com/en/spa/yu-sauna/): Editorial guide for a venue currently listed as operating. Yu Sauna opened in August 2026 at the former Royal Sauna premises. Run by the Oceanic Royal Spa team, it has bathing pools, saunas and a spacious lounge.
- [Number Nine Spa](https://sex-macau.com/en/spa/number-nine-sauna/): Editorial guide for a venue currently listed as operating. Number Nine Spa opened at Royal Dragon Hotel in April 2026.
- [Shang Pin Spa](https://sex-macau.com/en/spa/shang-pin-spa/): Editorial guide for a venue currently listed as operating. Shang Pin Spa opened in July 2025 on Level 2 of Lisboeta Macau, in unit L2 R95.
- [Majesty Spa](https://sex-macau.com/en/spa/majesty-spa/): Editorial guide for a venue currently listed as operating. Majesty Spa is inside Harbourview Hotel at Macau Fisherman's Wharf, close to the Outer Harbour Ferry Terminal.
- [The Excellent Sauna](https://sex-macau.com/en/spa/the-excellent-sauna/): Editorial guide for a venue currently listed as operating. The Excellent Sauna opened in May 2017 on the tenth floor of Grand Emperor Hotel.
- [Empire Sauna](https://sex-macau.com/en/spa/empire-sauna/): Editorial guide for a venue currently listed as operating. Empire Sauna opened on the Macau Peninsula in April 2026, with a boutique hotel-style lobby, spacious bathing pools and comfortable rest areas.
- [East Castle Spa](https://sex-macau.com/en/spa/east-castle-spa/): Editorial guide for a venue currently listed as operating. East Castle Spa is one of Macau's long-established sauna venues, occupying the third and fourth floors of Casa Real Hotel.
- [Victoria Sauna](https://sex-macau.com/en/spa/victoria-sauna/): Editorial guide for a venue currently listed as operating. Victoria Sauna occupies the fifth floor of L'Arc Hotel, near MGM Macau, Wynn Macau and Grand Lisboa.

## Temporarily Closed Venue References

- [Manhao Spa](https://sex-macau.com/en/spa/manhao-spa/): Reference only; the site currently lists this venue as temporarily closed. Manhao Spa opened at Grandview Hotel in Taipa in May 2026. Its large bathing area and lounges are best enjoyed with a few hours to spare.
- [M CLUB](https://sex-macau.com/en/spa/m-club/): Reference only; the site currently lists this venue as temporarily closed. MCLUB is located inside Waldo Hotel and is currently temporarily closed.
- [Number One Sauna](https://sex-macau.com/en/spa/number-one-sauna/): Reference only; the site currently lists this venue as temporarily closed. Number One Sauna is currently temporarily closed and is not accepting guests or bookings.
- [Familia Nobre](https://sex-macau.com/en/spa/familia-nobre/): Reference only; the site currently lists this venue as temporarily closed. Familia Nobre was known for its spacious pools, ornate interiors and extensive facilities. This long-established Macau sauna is currently temporarily closed.
- [Oceanic Royal Spa](https://sex-macau.com/en/spa/oceanic-royal-spa/): Reference only; the site currently lists this venue as temporarily closed. Oceanic Royal Spa was based at Inn Hotel Macau in Taipa, near The Venetian Macao.
- [18 Sauna](https://sex-macau.com/en/spa/eighteen-sauna/): Reference only; the site currently lists this venue as temporarily closed. 18 Sauna was a long-established Macau venue on the sixth floor of Hotel Golden Dragon.
